entities.summary: Goddess on the Throne is a terracotta figurine found at the site of the Tjerrtorja spinning mill in Pristina, the capital city of Kosovo, in 1956. The seated terracotta figure is a well-preserved specimen of small Neolithic Vinča culture. It measures 18.5 cm (7.3 in) high and is dated to 5700–4500 BC.
